noun_definition: transitionod-nd refers to the process of transitioning between the OD (Online Dashboard) and ND (Native Dashboard) applications while managing workspace settings related to tax options.
Tax refers to a setting in the workspace configuration that, when enabled or disabled, affects the navigation and functionality between the ND and OD applications.
Page refers to the specific interface in the ND App where users can manage tax settings for a workspace.
Back refers to a navigation option in the ND App that is expected to redirect the user to the workspace editor page after disabling the tax option in OD.
ws selection refers to the process of choosing a specific workspace within the OD application after logging in, as described in the steps taken by the user in the issue.
